hypotheses.R1_all_initial_sign_outliers_survive: All 20 conditioned axes still exceed every sign-coordination null with 64 rather than eight replicates.
hypotheses.R2_families_survive_two_null_types: At least three of five families have at least three of four axes with empirical p at most 0.05 under both sign and coefficient-pairing nulls.
hypotheses.R3_semantic_subspaces_beat_fair_random_s: At least three of five family subspaces have median canonical-axis top-four energy above the 95th percentile of equally canonicalized random four-dimensional output subspaces.
hypotheses.R4_enrichment_is_not_only_the_energy_lea: At least three families exceed the random-subspace 95th percentile after excluding canonical axis zero.
hypotheses.R5_the_strict_powerlaw_rule_remains_low_: At most four of the 20 semantic conditioned axes have positive leading excess above the previously frozen power-law fit.
